from pathlib import Path
for f in Path('Tests/Fuzzers/RegressionTests/regression_samples').glob('crash-*'):
    data=f.read_bytes()
    print('\n###',f.name)
    print('pcap magic',data[:4].hex())
    # print first few packet header fields after global header 24 bytes
    if len(data)>=40:
        import struct
        ts_sec, ts_usec, incl, orig = struct.unpack('<IIII', data[24:40])
        print('pkt1',ts_sec,ts_usec,incl,orig)
